text.ja: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML この問題の式、参照の条件、計算法、公開済みのコードをたどります。 保存済みの結果図 保存した浅角度の実電場を周期y方向へ再構成。灰色はPML領域です。 周期y方向の1周期を表示しています。波形を見やすくするため、x軸とy軸の表示縮尺は異なります。 方程式・問題の定義 c=1、均質Lorentz媒質ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12はPML内まで連続。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時に細分化します。垂直粗格子はpeak6、弱減衰細格子対照はpeak12。長さ64、層幅12、中心32、幅4、carrier6は固定です。 受動Lorentz・Ohmic分散Maxwell場 ∂tH=−∇×E,ε∞∂tE=∇×H−σE−J ∂tP=J,∂tJ=fE−ω02P−γJ,f=Δεω02 ε∞>0,f,σ,γ≥0 正の物質エネルギーと直接Ohmic/γ仕事を持つ単一受動Lorentz極。代表式は3Dですが、実装は周期y単一kyの2D s/p成分制限です。PML数値仕事は物理散逸と同一視しません。 実行例で使う式 補助実行例実行例の定義・検証式 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML ∂tψ=−sx(ψ+Dxu),DxPMLu=Dxu+ψ ψn=bψn−1+c(Dn+Dn−1),b=1−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2,c=−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2 ΔEmod+Wphysical−WPML=0 80度の中心位相角を持つ有限波束をT=700まで進め、境界誤差を同格子の無PML参照から分離します。 厳密解・参照解 t)^n\widehat U^0(k_x),\quad K_y=2\sin(k_y\Delta y/2)/\Delta y 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。 実行例の参照と結果 補助実行例 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Actual saved grazing electric field reconstructed over the periodic y direction; gray shading marks the PML. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible. Equations and problem definitions Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed. Passive Lorentz–Ohmic Maxwell fields ∂tH=−∇×E,ε∞∂tE=∇×H−σE−J ∂tP=J,∂tJ=fE−ω02P−γJ,f=Δεω02 ε∞>0,f,σ,γ≥0 A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation. Formulations used by execution examples Supplementary execution exampleExample definition or validation formula Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium ∂tψ=−sx(ψ+Dxu),DxPMLu=Dxu+ψ ψn=bψn−1+c(Dn+Dn−1),b=1−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2,c=−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2 ΔEmod+Wphysical−WPML=0 Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid. Exact and reference solutions Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged. Finite-grid numerical referenceReference for the same problem Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet \widehat U^n(k_x)=M(k_x,\Delta t)^n\widehat U^0(k_x),\quad K_y=2\sin(k_y\Delta y/2)/\Delta y The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700. The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability. References and results of execution examples Supplementary execution example Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged. Saved result / JSON Reference and validation details → Numerical methods Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states. Methods used by this problem’s execution examples Yee finite-difference time-domain method Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Two-step leapfrog Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Implicit midpoint Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Code and execution Supplementary execution example Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid. Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed. Use these commands in the working directory specified by the execution guide after extracting the ZIP. A command may execute several cases in the package. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Validation limits The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.
